Dear Hiring Manager,
I am writing to express my interest in the AI/ML Internship at your organization. I am
currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science and
Engineering at Exalt College of Engineering and Technology. I am passionate about
Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Software Development, and I
am eager to apply my skills to real-world challenges while learning from experienced
professionals.
I have developed a strong foundation in Python, C++, SQL, React, FastAPI, Scikit-learn,
TensorFlow, OpenCV, and MySQL through academic projects and hands-on learning. My
key projects include an AI Career Assistant for resume analysis and career
recommendations, a Face Recognition Attendance System, and an SMS Spam Detection
System, which strengthened my software development, machine learning, and problem-
